sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was materially reduced: Q2'22 paid net additions forecast is -2.0m vs +1.5m in the year-ago quarter, and full-year revenue growth guidance is held at ~10% with no raise. Management explicitly acknowledges 'revenue growth has slowed considerably' and cites structural headwinds including high household penetration, account sharing, and competition. The tone is defensive and cautious, with no positive inflection in forward expectations.

summary.revenue: Q1'22 revenue $7,868 million, up 9.8% year-over-year (Y/Y growth slowed from 24.2% in Q1'21).
summary.eps: Diluted EPS $3.53 vs $3.75 a year ago, including a $162 million non-cash unrealized gain from FX remeasurement on Euro debt.
summary.guidance: Q2'22 forecast revenue ~$8,053 million (~10% Y/Y growth), paid net additions -2.0m (vs +1.5m a year ago), full-year 2022 operating margin target 19%-20%.
summary.margin: Q1'22 operating margin 25.1% (down from 27.4% a year ago); full-year 2022 target 19%-20%.
key_risks: Revenue growth has slowed considerably due to high household penetration, account sharing, and competition.
Q1'22 paid net additions were -0.2m vs guidance of 2.5m, with soft acquisition across all regions.
Russia suspension and Ukraine invasion impacted EMEA membership (-0.7m net adds).
Macro factors including sluggish economic growth, inflation, and geopolitical events are likely having an impact.
Account sharing with over 100m additional households creates monetization challenges.
key_opportunities: Monetizing account sharing: over 100m households using another household's account represent a large short- to mid-term opportunity.
International growth: well over half of the world's broadband homes don't yet pay for Netflix, representing huge future growth potential.
Content strength: big Q1'22 hits like Bridgerton season 2 (627m hours viewed) and Inventing Anna (512m hours).
Non-English language content success: three out of six most popular TV seasons ever are non-English titles (Squid Game, La Casa de Papel Part 4, All Of Us Are Dead).
